name: Honeypot
author: Kirin
short: Automatically contains accounts that post in Unicornia's honeypot channel
description: Bans new accounts and quarantines established members that post in Unicornia's hardcoded honeypot channel, with durable role restoration for staff.
install_msg: Thanks for installing the honeypot cog. Review the README deployment checklist before loading it.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild-scoped Discord user IDs, prior role IDs, and quarantine timestamps so staff can restore quarantined members. Red data-deletion requests remove the user's quarantine records from every guild.
